articleBody:
Before your beautiful new cabinets for your Alameda home are installed, there are some key things you'll want to double-check to make sure everything goes smoothly. Getting these details right upfront can prevent delays, reorders, and costly mistakes. This checklist will help you prepare for a successful cabinet installation.

- [ ] Confirm layout and appliance specifications — Make sure the final layout drawings match your vision and all appliance dimensions (width, height, depth) are verified and accounted for, ensuring everything fits perfectly.
- [ ] Take and verify site measurements — Have accurate measurements of your space, including wall dimensions, ceiling height, and window/door openings, double-checked against the cabinet order to catch any discrepancies early.
- [ ] Select cabinet construction, hardware, finish, and accessories — Ensure all your choices for materials, door styles, drawer slides, pulls, and internal accessories are finalized and documented, as last-minute changes can cause delays.
- [ ] Approve drawings or specifications — Give a final sign-off on all cabinet drawings and specifications. This confirms you agree with the design and details before manufacturing begins.
- [ ] Order materials — Confirm the order has been placed with accurate specifications and lead times have been communicated. Knowing when materials will arrive helps coordinate the installation schedule.
- [ ] Prepare the site — Ensure the installation area is clear, clean, and ready. This might include removing old cabinets, completing wall finishes, and having plumbing/electrical rough-ins in place.
- [ ] Plan for fillers, end panels, and clearances — Confirm that considerations for fillers to bridge gaps, end panels for exposed cabinet sides, and necessary clearances around appliances and doors are included in the design.

How to use this checklist:
Go through each item and physically check it off as you confirm it. This isn't just about reviewing; it's about actively verifying each step to ensure your cabinet project in Alameda moves forward without a hitch. If anything isn't checked off, it's a potential point of delay or error. Early preparation means a much smoother installation process for your new cabinets. Getting these things squared away before installation day helps things go really smoothly.
